mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ed2k_engine_action WHERE action_state = 'PENDING' OR (action_state = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now})) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM ed2k_engine_action WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND action_state IN ('PENDING', 'APPLYING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
mapper.update: UPDATE ed2k_engine_action SET action_state = 'APPLYING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_count = #{expectedAttemptCount} AND action_state IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
UPDATE ed2k_engine_action SET action_state = 'APPLIED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ed2k_engine_action SET action_state = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ed2k_engine_action SET action_state = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ed2k_engine_action SET action_state = 'PENDING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE action_state = 'APPLYING'
